description:
The three integration-test-only rule-serialization publics move behind the `test-support` feature so they leave the default public surface.

## Background

`SerializedRuleSet`, `SchemaFile`, and `serialize_ruleset` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/rule_serialize.rs`) are `pub` solely for integration-test crates; they have no production consumer outside `repository_state`. Rather than leaving them on the default surface, they adopt the established `test-support` feature twin pattern: public under the feature, `pub(crate)` without it, so internal callers resolve identically in both feature states.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `SerializedRuleSet`, `SchemaFile`, and `serialize_ruleset` are exposed only under the `test-support` feature - public with the feature, `pub(crate)` without - and are absent from the default public surface.
- [hard] REQ-02: Crate-internal callers of these items resolve identically whether or not the feature is enabled.
- [hard] REQ-03: The workspace builds, `cargo test --workspace` passes, and `cargo clippy --lib` on the default surface reports zero warnings.

## Notes

The items adopt the same feature-on-`pub` / feature-off-`pub(crate)` twin pattern used for the other test-support surfaces.
title: Gate the test-only rule-serialization publics behind test-support
